title: Compact-support projection at constant coefficients
statement: Let R be a finite commutative ring, c a compactification of f:X to Y [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], K an arbitrary object of D(X_proet,R), and N an arbitrary R-module. If the unbounded pro-etale compact-support functor at c is a left adjoint, the canonical projection component at K and the constant sheaf N in degree zero is invertible. The projection component is exactly [def-exchange-projection], with tensor [def-weil-derived-tensor] and ambient operations [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations].

source.place: Coefficient comparison proof; Stacks Tags 06YY, 07A6 and 0GL6.

proof.text: Precompose the proper projection transformation, evaluated at the open extension by zero of K, with the exact derived constant-sheaf functor. Monoidal unitality makes its component at R[0] invertible. Compute the derived tensor comparison on flat resolutions to obtain shift compatibility; the two functors are triangulated.

The source tensor functor is a left adjoint. The inverse open projection isomorphism rewrites the target as inverse images, tensor with K, and the whole compact-support functor. Each is a left adjoint, so both functors precomposed with derived constants preserve all coproducts. The already proved library theorem DerivedCategory.isIso_of_isIso_app_singleFunctor_obj_self, in WeilConjectures.CategoryTheory.DerivedCategory.ModuleCatGeneration, now proves the transformation invertible on every derived coefficient object, hence at N[0]. No finite resolution needs to be reproved.

The compact-support projection component is the proper projection followed by proper direct image of the inverse open projection isomorphism and of the pullback composition isomorphism. These last factors are invertible, so the previous step proves the stated component invertible. The irreducible component definition is exactly this canonical map, with its explicit computation equation.

proof_origin: C3: use the existing localizing generation theorem for D(R), after proving the projection target a left adjoint by the open projection formula.

lean.statement:
theorem finite_support_projection
    (R : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing R] [Finite R]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (c : Compactification f)
    [(Rf_!(c)[ModuleCat.{u + 1} R]).IsLeftAdjoint]
    (K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R)))
    (N : ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) :
    IsIso (compactSupportProjectionComponent (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) c K
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
        ((constantSheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R)).obj N)))
